# smart-immunizations-uploads

The incoming queue: one `uploads/<slug>/intake.json` (`folio-intake/v1`) per capture, before ingestion. It already held the intakes of the WHO publications ingested into `library/`; since bean folio-assistant-djj5 (owner, 2026-11-03: "Catalogue + uploads/ copy") it also records the capture of each cited work that is not ingested (upstream URL, when, size and sha256, licence), naming its catalogue record and item node. NOT L1 and not greppable as corpus. A capture's bytes are committed only once a licence that permits a copy is established.

Part of [WHO SMART Guidelines — Immunizations](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `smart-immunizations-uploads`, holding `uploads`.
